Translation: Some actions cost Action Points (AP), as you receive {ap_each_turn} each turn for free — spend them wisely.
Represents your likelihood of producing an {CHAR_HEI_C}heir{##}. It is influenced by both partners' {CHAR_FER_C}fertility{##} and the quality of your {CHAR_STA_C}relationship{##}.

In this world, there are two castes you're born into. While Workers trade labor for pay and never ascend, Citizens can build {CHAR_WEA_C}wealth{##}, rise through {T_C}titles{##}, and take part in the town's {O_TYP_CIVOFF_C}political{##} life.

Welcome to the Matchmaking Fair. Take a look around and get acquainted with the hopeful faces gathered here. Whether you're seeking love for yourself or a suitable match for a family member, everyone here is looking for much the same thing: L-O-V-E.
Click on a character to learn more about them. You can see their name, skills, desirable and undesirable traits, and even their wealth. If only life were always this transparent.

Take your time and choose carefully. Once someone catches your eye, click on the lucky candidate to begin courting them yourself or arrange a courtship for a family member. Should you choose to pursue them yourself, a more private corner of the park awaits, where you can get to know each other better.

Now that you have found a more private corner of the park, click on your chosen partner to interact with them. Sweet-talk them, bring them gifts, and give them plenty of reasons to want to marry you sooner.
If you need to leave, you can always come back later, as long as your chosen one has not been led down the aisle by you or, God forbid, by someone else.
Courting leads to marriage — and marriage to {CHAR_HEI_C}heirs{##} and the continuation of your {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##}.
The bar tracks your progress toward winning your partner's hand. Be the first to fill it. Love can be a competitive sport.
{A_SENGIF_C}Send gifts{##} or {A_SWETAL_C}sweet-talk{##} to hasten the progress.
A wedding has been arranged. The ceremony will take place on the turn following the acceptance of the proposal.
What symbol will represent your house? Choose the crest by which your family will be known.
A family line that endures across generations, shaped by the choices, fortunes, and failures of its members. Through {CHAR_HEI_C}heirs{##}, your dynasty outlives any single member.
Some bloodlines are better than others.
The Dynasty Head is most influential and wealthy member of each {CHAR_DYN_C}family{##}.

Energy represents your physical capacity to perform actions and tasks. It {CHAR_ENEREG_C}regenerates{##} over time and impacts both {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} and {CO_COM_C}combat{##} effectiveness.
If energy drops to zero, you are {ST_CHR_KNODOW_C}knocked down{##}.
Recharge with a refreshing {I_ENDPOT_C}endurance drink{##} or consider investing in {B_IMP_BETBED_C}better beds{##}.
Even the most tireless body has its limits.
You can {CHAR_ENEREG_C}restore{##} your energy, but only up to a certain level.
Travelers from the east hold that {B_IMP_HEA_C}warmth{##} is the root of all life's vigor.
Your {CHAR_ENE_C}energy{##} regenerates every hour, and a good night's sleep restores a good portion of it, so each {C_TRN_C}turn{##} begins refreshed.
Those living in a {C_QUA_C}quarter{##} blessed with a {B_PUB_FOU_C}fountain{##} recover even faster.
Influences your {CHAR_CHABABY_C}chance of producing heirs{##}. Waste no time — youth and {CHAR_HP_C}health{##} do not last forever.
Younger mothers are more fertile, while fertility declines with age — more sharply for women than for men. Fathers are less affected, though age still takes its toll.
The healthier you are, the longer you live — and the better your {CHAR_FER_C}fertility{##}.
Years wear the body down. {A_PHYCHE_C}Visit the physician{##} or drink the right potions to improve your health.
Any family member may inherit the dynasty, provided they are at least {heir_min_age} {heir_min_age}|plural(one=year,other=years) old.

The successor to your {T_C}titles{##}, property, and {CHAR_WEA_C}wealth{##}. Your heir carries the legacy forward and keeps your {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##} alive. Must be {heir_min_age} {heir_min_age}|plural(one=year,other=years) or older.
Any family member may inherit the dynasty, provided they are at least {heir_min_age} {heir_min_age}|plural(one=year,other=years) old.
Your Personal Inventory accepts {I_TYP_INVITE_C}Inventory Items{##} only. Once inside, items cannot be moved — only used, given away, or discarded.
Once inside, items cannot be moved — only used, given away, or discarded.
{A_SWETAL_C}Sweet words{##} and {A_SENGIF_C}fine gifts{##} win hearts. Hearts win marriages. Marriages win {CHAR_HEI_C}heirs{##}.
Back on the market and free to seek another match.
They said yes. The marriage ceremony will follow soon.
Marriage has its pleasures. {A_PRITIM_C}Share a private moment{##} to increase the chances of producing {CHAR_HEI_C}heirs{##} and securing the {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##}'s future.
{CHAR_HEI_C}Heirs{##}do not make themselves. Find someone to court and secure the {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##}.
Renown measures how much you are respected in the city. It reflects upon the {CHAR_RENDYN_C}dynasty{##} and its members, and is inherited across generations.
High renown can make you more persuasive and command greater respect, but it may also draw unwanted attention — from rivals, criminals, and those seeking to take advantage of your success.
Renown measures how much you are respected in the city. Compared to the rest of your family members, your renown counts more towards the {CHAR_RENDYN_C}dynasty prestige{##}.
A dynasty's renown is the combined {CHAR_REN_C}renown{##} of all its members.
Courtship is where love starts. Guide it well and it leads to marriage, an {CHAR_HEI_C}heir{##}, and a secure {CHAR_DYN_C}dynasty{##}.
The more you nurture it, the faster it blossoms. Try {A_SWETAL_C}sweet-talking{##} or {A_SENGIF_C}sending gifts{##}.
The Score measures someone's success based on their actions, achievements, and goals.
Handle physical confrontations more effectively, increasing your chance to hit the opponent in combat.

Skills are the measure of a man — in trade, in craft, and in service to one's lord. \nThey sharpen your tongue for a good {PM_CITSKILL_NEG_C}deal{##}, help you choose the right workers for each {A_ACT_C}task{##}, persuade others, and even give you a knack for {CR_CRI_C}crime{##}.
Read a {I_SKIBOOI_C}skill book{##} or invest in home improvements to {A_IMPSKI_C}hone your skills{##} without leaving the house.
Your expertise in handicraft enhances your businesses' efficiency, ensuring tasks are completed faster and with more successful outcomes.
Negotiate better prices, securing discounts when buying and increasing success when selling above market price.
Use the power of words to persuade others and turn them in your favor, influencing trials, elections, or any situation that requires convincing.
Use the art of deception to outsmart, outmaneuver, and sabotage your opponents, giving you the edge in {CR_CRI_C}crimes{##} while ensuring others do not take advantage of you.
Relationships are currency in this world. Opinion reflects someone's view of another and is not necessarily reciprocated.

The number you see on a character's portrait shows how that character views you. When comparing opinions between multiple characters, you can click on the number to switch views and see how others feel about the character you've selected.
What name will your family bear for generations to come?
All your heirs, as well as your spouse, will receive the same surname.
Your Wealth is shown in your Character Details.
Wealth is the total value of your assets, including cash, buildings, and carts.
A dynasty counts wealth not by owner, but by bloodline. Dynasty Wealth is the accumulated {CHAR_WEA_C}wealth{##} of all its members.
